items.title: Gallagher Re partners with Scrub AI for catastrophe modelling data cleaning
items.summary: Reinsurance broker Gallagher Re has engaged AI platform Scrub AI to automate the cleaning and standardisation of property binder exposure data.

items.title: RiverStone enters ILS market and completes QBE loss portfolio transfers
items.summary: Bermuda-based legacy specialist RiverStone International has entered the insurance-linked securities market alongside completing loss portfolio transfers with QBE.

items.title: Guernsey approves plan to keep mortgage interest tax relief
items.summary: Deputies in Guernsey have approved a budget amendment to maintain tax relief on mortgage interest, halting a phased withdrawal agreed in 2015.

items.title: FRC launches reviews into pension illustration assumptions and standards
items.summary: The Financial Reporting Council has initiated a call for feedback and a discussion paper on actuarial standards for pension illustrations.

items.title: Novel secures equity investment from Crestview Partners
items.summary: Novel Financial Holdings has received an investment from Crestview Partners to support its underwriting and insurance services expansion.

items.title: Government proposes guided retirement scheme for private sector workers
items.summary: Ministers have proposed a default guided retirement option intended to offer millions of private sector workers a guaranteed income for life.
